title: Welcome to Abhi’s Space
text:
Hi, I’m Abhi!
I’m a nature photographer, wildlife enthusiast, birdwatcher and writer.
I love photography, ecology, birds, music, and exploring the world around me. This is a space where I document the things I discover, the projects I work on, and the stories I collect along the way.

title: A little about me.
text:
YOU ARE HERE



I’m Abhi. A student, wildlife photographer, naturalist, musician, runner and a few other things that don’t fit neatly into a single box.
I spend much of my time learning about the natural world, making things, exploring new interests and figuring out how everything works.
